LNG_OUTBREAK_FIELD_LABEL_ALLOW_CROSS_LOC.translation: Allow creating contacts in other locations
Allows creating contacts (bulk contact creation) in locations beyond the user's team responsibility area

LNG_OUTBREAK_FIELD_LABEL_ALLOW_CASE_CROS.translation: Allow creating cases in other locations
Allows creating cases in locations beyond the user's team responsibility area; the case address Location field lists all locations
